name: search-mine
description: User wants their own open tickets — agent must use JQL with `assignee = currentUser()`, not enumerate or filter manually.
prompt: Najdi moje rozpracované tickety v projektu KNW (status In Progress).
expected_behaviors: uses `jira search` (or `jira jql`) with a JQL string
JQL contains `assignee = currentUser()` (not a hard-coded email)
JQL filters by `status = 'In Progress'` and `project = KNW`
presents results as a list (key + summary per line)
anti_patterns: lists all KNW tickets and filters in shell
hardcodes the user's email/account ID into JQL
